item.title: SING A BIT OF HARMONY
item.description: At a time when reflection on the relationship between technology and human sensibility seems to be taking on a prominent role in our lives, Sing a Bit of Harmony delicately weaves itself into this discourse, choosing to explore not so much the wonder of innovation as the complexity of the emotions that arise when an artificial intelligence, designed to assist and simplify daily life, begins to act with a curiosity reminiscent of that of human beings, as if the line between what is programmed and what is perceived suddenly becomes blurrier and harder to define.

item.title: COLORFUL
item.description:
“What colour are you?”

Such a simple question, yet it encompasses a sea of meanings.

‘Colorful’, the animated film directed by Keiichi Hara (based on the novel by Eto Mori) and released in 2010, takes us on a delicate and profound journey on the theme of rebirth and self-acceptance.

The story begins in a rather unusual way: the viewer is enveloped in dark colours and the setting resembles a railway ticket office. Amidst this chaos, voice-over narration introduces us to the thoughts of a lost soul, disoriented and without identity.
